id: title:Gilbert09:suggest the domain property for a www hostname

review.posthog_relevance: Google Search Console ingestion and domain property matching, specifically handling the distinction between bare domains and www. prefixes to prevent false negatives in domain registration suggestions.
review.reason: The change implements a substantive, bounded capability: it adds a new candidate URL generation step (P1.F1.H2) and documentation clarifying the matching behavior (P1.F1.H1) for Google Search Console ingestion. This addresses a specific edge case where user input with a 'www.' prefix might not match a registered bare domain, potentially causing ingestion failures or missed data. P1
review.uncertainty: The tier is assigned based on the implementation of a new matching behavior and its accompanying tests. While the benefit is clear for users relying on this ingestion, the exact volume of affected users or historical failure rates are not established by this code alone. The score does not account for unverified adoption or broader systemic risk reduction.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs detected. No missing context. No binary or generated-only hunks. No score assigned yet.

observations.behavior: Adds a comment explaining that a bare domain property covers every subdomain, including those with a www. hostname, regardless of scheme.
observations.code_quote: A ``www.`` hostname, with or without a scheme, also matches the domain property of the bare
observations.posthog_connection: Clarifies the matching behavior between user-entered URLs and registered domain properties in Google Search Console ingestion, helping users understand why a URL with www. might not match a bare domain registration.

observations.behavior: Adds a new candidate URL to the suggestion loop: the bare domain without the www. prefix, alongside the original candidates.
observations.posthog_connection: Implements the behavior described in P1.F1.H1 by explicitly checking if the registered domain matches the user's input after stripping the www. prefix, allowing the system to suggest the registered domain even if the user entered a www. variant.

observations.behavior: Adds a test case asserting that a bare www. hostname should suggest the registered domain property, and another asserting that a URL with a path should not suggest anything.
observations.code_quote: # A bare www hostname matches the domain property of the bare domain.
observations.posthog_connection: Provides regression tests and documentation for the new matching behavior, ensuring that users entering www.example.com are correctly suggested the registered domain property sc-domain:example.com, while URLs with paths are not suggested.
